words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.tr: 短语动词. 取得全优成绩；每门功课都得A
words.ex: He gets straight A's in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上总是得全A。
words.en: To achieve the highest possible grades in all subjects.

words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.tr: n. 汉城；首尔（韩国的首都和最大城市）
words.ex: Seoul is the capital of South Korea.
words.ex_cn: 汉城是韩国的首都。
words.en: Seoul is the capital and largest metropolis of South Korea, known for its dynamic culture, advanced technology, and historical landmarks.

words.ex: She lives in South Korea.
words.ex_cn: 她住在韩国。
words.en: South Korea is a country in East Asia, located on the southern half of the Korean Peninsula.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 极想做某事；迫切希望；非常渴望
words.ex_cn: 他急着想看他的新手机。
words.en: If you say that you are dying for something or are dying to do something, you mean that you want to have it or do it very much.

words.tr: phrase. 非常渴望做某事；迫不及待想做某事
words.ex: He is dying to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后急着去踢足球。
words.en: To have a very strong desire or eagerness to do something.

words.ex: There was a scramble for the last ticket.
words.ex_cn: 大家争相抢购最后一张票。
words.en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you. Scramble can also mean to compete or struggle with others for something that is in short supply.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr:
n. 泛光灯；强光灯
v. 用泛光灯照亮
words.ex: The floodlight shines on the soccer field at night.
words.ex_cn: 探照灯在夜晚照耀着足球场。
words.en: A floodlight is a large, powerful light that is used to illuminate a wide area, especially outdoors.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.ex_cn: 请小心横过街道。
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.ex: To be honest, I don't like this food.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这种食物。
words.en: used when you are telling someone what you really think

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: He manages to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都能设法完成家庭作业。
words.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr: n. 体育运动；田径运动；竞技；
words.ex: He loves athletics and runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱体育运动，每天早上跑步。
words.en: Athletics refers to sports in general, especially those that involve physical strength, speed, or endurance, such as running, jumping, and throwing.

words.tr: phrase. 奥林匹克运动会；奥运会
words.ex: The Olympic games happen every four years.
words.ex_cn: 奥林匹克运动会每四年举行一次。
words.en: The Olympic Games are a major international event featuring summer and winter sports, in which thousands of athletes participate in a variety of competitions.

words.tr: phrase. 奥林匹克运动会；奥运会
words.ex: The Olympics happen every four years.
words.ex_cn: 奥运会每四年举行一次。
words.en: The Olympic Games are a major international event featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 田径项目（尤指跑道上进行的赛跑、跨栏等比赛）
words.ex: He runs in the track event every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都参加田径项目。
words.en: A track event is a competitive athletic event held on a running track, such as sprints, hurdles, or relays.

words.tr: phrase. 田赛项目（指田径运动中跳跃和投掷等在场地上进行的项目）
words.ex: He competes in the field event called long jump.
words.ex_cn: 他参加被称为跳远的田赛项目。
words.en: A field event is a competition in athletics that involves jumping or throwing, such as the long jump, shot put, or javelin throw, as opposed to a track event which involves running.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr:
n. 跳栏赛跑
v. 越过障碍；克服；“hurdle”的现在分词
words.ex: He is hurdling over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在跨过篱笆。
words.en: Hurdling is the act of running and jumping over obstacles (hurdles) in a race.

words.tr: phrase. 铅球（田径运动项目）
words.ex: He practices shot put every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习铅球。
words.en: A track and field event in which a heavy metal ball is thrown as far as possible.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: He threw the javelin farther than anyone else.
words.ex_cn: 他投出的标枪比任何人都远。
words.en: A javelin is a light spear designed primarily for casting as a ranged weapon.

words.tr: n. 马拉松赛跑；耐力赛；
words.ex: He ran a marathon last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期日跑了一场马拉松赛跑。
words.en: A marathon is a long-distance running event with an official distance of 42.195 kilometers (26 miles 385 yards), usually run as a road race. The event was instituted in commemoration of the fabled run of the Greek soldier Pheidippides, a messenger from the Battle of Marathon to Athens.

words.ex: He built his endurance by running every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早晨跑步来增强耐力。
words.en: The ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving up.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.tr: phrase. 一连串的；一系列；一套
words.ex: He made a series of mistakes on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一连串的错误。
words.en: A number of things or events that are arranged or happen one after the other.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He competes in the decathlon every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年参加十项全能比赛。
words.en: A decathlon is a combined event in athletics consisting of ten track and field events.

words.tr: adj. 全能的；多方面的；多才多艺的
words.ex: He is an all-round athlete who plays soccer, basketball, and tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名全能运动员，踢足球、打篮球和打网球。
words.en: Having a wide range of abilities or uses; versatile.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.tr: phrase. 在许多方面；从多方面来看；在很多意义上
words.ex: In many ways, this book is better than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 在很多方面，这本书比上一本更好。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is true or applicable in several different aspects or respects.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的； v. 取得资格；“qualify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有资格的老师。
words.en: Having the necessary qualifications for a particular job or task.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.ex: He makes money by selling cakes.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖蛋糕赚钱。
words.en: To earn or obtain money through work, investment, or other means.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 被迫做某事；不得不做
words.ex: He is forced to leave school because of money problems.
words.ex_cn: 他因为经济问题被迫离开学校。
words.en: To be compelled to do something against one's will.

words.ex: He was forced to leave school because of money problems.
words.ex_cn: 他因为经济问题被迫退学。
words.en: To be compelled to perform an action, often against one's will.

words.tr: adj. 增补性的；补充性的；
words.ex: The teacher gave supplementary notes for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师为这节课提供了增补性的笔记。
words.en: Supplementary things are added to something in order to improve it or make it more complete.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.tr: n. 拱廊；有拱廊的街道；游乐中心
words.ex: The old arcade has stone pillars and a tiled roof.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的拱廊有石柱和瓦片屋顶。
words.en: A covered passage with arches along one or both sides.

words.tr: phrase. 电子游戏厅；街机游戏场所
words.ex: He plays video arcade games after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后玩视频街机游戏。
words.en: A video arcade is a place where people can play video games on arcade machines, usually for a fee.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: The detective solved the mystery with clues.
words.ex_cn: 侦探用线索破解了谜案。
words.en: A detective is someone whose job is to discover what has happened in a crime or other situation and to find the people involved.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意做某事；乐意去做
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are ready and eager to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意做某事；乐意去做某事
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮朋友做作业。
words.en: If you are willing to do something, you are ready and eager to do it.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.tr: phrase. 按照某人自己的速度；以某人自己的节奏
words.ex: You can learn to read at your own pace.
words.ex_cn: 你可以按照自己的节奏学习阅读。
words.en: To do something at the speed that one is comfortable with, without feeling rushed.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: They maintain correspondence through letters.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过信件保持通信联系。
words.en: Communication by exchanging letters with someone; a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.

words.ex: He takes a correspondence course to learn English at home.
words.ex_cn: 他通过函授课程在家学习英语。
words.en: A course of study in which student and tutors communicate by post.

words.ex: The audio signal was clear and loud.
words.ex_cn: 音频信号清晰响亮。
words.en: Audio refers to sound, especially when recorded, transmitted, or reproduced.

words.ex: The CD is a type of disc.
words.ex_cn: CD是一种圆盘。
words.en: A disc is a flat, circular object or a device used to store information in a form that can be read by a computer.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；
v. 邮寄；
words.ex: I checked my mail this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上查了邮件。
words.en: Mail refers to letters, packages, etc., that are sent or delivered by post.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.tr: phrase. 发表评论；作出评论
words.ex: He makes comments on the homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天对作业做出评论。
words.en: To express an opinion or remark, often in a written or spoken form.

words.ex: He uses e-learning to study math at home.
words.ex_cn: 他使用在线学习在家学习数学。
words.en: E-learning refers to the use of electronic technologies to access educational curriculum outside of a traditional classroom.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: He shows self-discipline by waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早起展现自律。
words.en: The ability to control yourself and to make yourself work hard or behave in a particular way without needing anyone else to tell you what to do.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He felt a sense of achievement after finishing the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在完成比赛后感到一种成就感。
words.en: A feeling of satisfaction that you have achieved something important or difficult.

words.ex: He feels a sense of satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到一种满足感。
words.en: A feeling of contentment or fulfillment that comes from achieving something or from something that meets one's expectations.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is fashionable now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: Something that is fashionable is popular or approved of at a particular time.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: Please bring along your notebook to class.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的笔记本带到课堂上来。
words.en: To take someone or something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr: n. 宽松的女短衫；女衬衫
words.ex: She wears a white blouse to work.
words.ex_cn: 她上班穿一件白色上衣。
words.en: A blouse is a piece of clothing for women, which covers their body from the neck to the waist or slightly below, and which usually has long sleeves and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He bought a piece of clothing at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一件衣服。
words.en: An item worn on the body, such as a shirt, dress, or coat.

words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.tr: v. 买得起；担负得起；有时间做；
words.ex: I can't afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.tr: phrase. 热衷于；喜爱；对…极感兴趣
words.ex: He is keen on playing football.
words.ex_cn: 他非常热衷于踢足球。
words.en: If you are keen on something, you like it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他的钥匙。
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后水很凉爽。
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: n. 教练员；运动鞋；训练者；驯兽师；“trainer”的复数；
words.ex: The trainers helped the players improve their skills.
words.ex_cn: 教练员帮助球员提高他们的技能。
words.en: Trainers are shoes worn for sports or casual occasions. They are designed to be comfortable and supportive for physical activities.

words.tr:
n. 废墟；
v. 破坏；
words.ex: The old temple is now a ruin.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙现在已成为废墟。
words.en: Ruin means the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of disintegrating or being destroyed.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.tr:
n. 假发
v. 痛骂；严责；给…装假发
words.ex: She wore a wig to cover her bald head.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一顶假发来遮盖她光秃的头。
words.en: A wig is a covering of false hair which you wear on your head, for example because you are bald or because you want to cover up your own hair.

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 海狸；海狸毛皮
v. 勤奋工作
words.ex: The beaver builds a dam with sticks and mud.
words.ex_cn: 海狸用树枝和泥土筑坝。
words.en: A beaver is a large rodent with a broad, flat tail, known for building dams and lodges in rivers.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: Bell bottoms went out of style in the 1980s.
words.ex_cn: 喇叭裤在20世纪80年代过时了。
words.en: To become no longer fashionable or popular.

words.tr: v. “say”的现在分词；说； n. 谚语；警句；
words.ex: He is saying goodbye to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友们道别。
words.en: A short, well-known expression that states a general truth or gives advice.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr: phrase. 校服；学生统一穿着的制服
words.ex: He wears a school uniform every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿校服。
words.en: A school uniform is a standard set of clothes which students are required to wear at school.

words.tr: phrase. 公立学校（美国、苏格兰等地指政府资助的免费学校）；公学（英格兰传统指收费、寄宿的私立中学，如伊顿公学）
words.ex: He goes to a public school near his home.
words.ex_cn: 他去家附近的公立学校。
words.en: A public school is a school that is funded by the government and provides free education to children.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: Maryland is a state on the east coast of the USA.
words.ex_cn: 马里兰州位于美国东海岸。
words.en: Maryland is a state located in the Mid-Atlantic region of the United States, known for its waterways and the Chesapeake Bay.

words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.ex: His headaches are linked to too much screen time.
words.ex_cn: 他的头痛与过多的屏幕时间有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.tr:
n. 一群；一帮；一伙
v. 成群结队；结成一伙；合伙攻击
words.ex: The gang stole a car last night.
words.ex_cn: 那群人昨晚偷了一辆车。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often deliberately cause trouble.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr: phrase. 同伴压力；同辈压力
words.ex: He gave in to peer pressure and smoked cigarettes.
words.ex_cn: 他屈服于同龄人的压力，抽了香烟。
words.en: Influence from members of one's peer group.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: Each child shows their individuality in different ways.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都以不同的方式展现他们的个性。
words.en: The qualities that make someone or something different from others.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: It is unlikely to rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天不大可能下雨。
words.en: If you say that something is unlikely to happen or unlikely to be true, you mean that you think it will not happen or that it is not true, although it is not certain.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr:
adj. 全国性的；
adv. 在全国范围内；
words.ex: The nationwide campaign helped many families.
words.ex_cn: 这项全国性的活动帮助了许多家庭。
words.en: Extending or occurring throughout a whole nation.

words.tr:
adj. 免下车即可得到服务的
n. 免下车餐馆；免下车电影院；免下车商业场所
words.ex: We ate burgers at a drive-in last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在汽车餐厅吃了汉堡。
words.en: A drive-in is a place such as a restaurant or cinema where you can be served or watch a film without leaving your car.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.tr: n. 加利福尼亚（美国州名）
words.ex: He lives in California.
words.ex_cn: 他住在加利福尼亚。
words.en: A state in the western United States on the Pacific Ocean; known for its diverse geography and culture.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr: v. 使留下深刻印象；使铭记；
words.ex: His speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲给在场的每个人留下了深刻印象。
words.en: If someone or something impresses you, you feel great admiration for them.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: n. 出口；发泄途径；经销店；折扣店
words.ex: The river flows out through an outlet.
words.ex_cn: 河水通过一个出口流出。
words.en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow out, or a point in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: He ran swiftly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: If something is done swiftly, it is done quickly and without delay.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.ex: The paper proves his ownership of the house.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件证明了他对这所房子的物主身份。
words.en: Ownership is the state or fact of owning something.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: He will pass the test, no doubt.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会通过考试。
words.en: You use no doubt to indicate that you are making a judgment or statement that you think is probably true, although you are not certain.

words.ex: He works at a chain store near his house.
words.ex_cn: 他在家附近的连锁店工作。
words.en: A chain store is one of a series of shops owned by one company and selling the same type of goods.

words.ex: He is likely to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能通过考试。
words.en: If you say that something is likely to happen or is likely to be true, you mean that it will probably happen or that it is probably true.

words.tr: phrase. 很可能做某事；有倾向做某事
words.ex: He is likely to fail the test.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能考不及格。
words.en: If someone or something is likely to do a particular thing, they will very probably do it.

words.tr: phrase. 某种的；某一类的；这样那样的
words.ex: He needs a gift of some kind for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他需要为她的生日准备一种礼物。
words.en: Used to indicate that something belongs to a particular type or category, without specifying exactly what it is.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: I bought milk at the convenience store.
words.ex_cn: 我在便利店买了牛奶。
words.en: A convenience store is a small retail business that stocks a range of everyday items such as groceries, snack foods, confectionery, soft drinks, tobacco products, and may also offer money order and wire transfer services. These stores are known for their extended operating hours and convenient locations.

words.tr: phrase. 突然（或匆匆）走进；顺道去一下
words.ex: I will pop into the shop to buy some bread.
words.ex_cn: 我会顺便进商店买些面包。
words.en: If you pop into a place, you visit it briefly, usually for a short time and often without planning to do so in advance.

words.tr:
v. 滚动；
n. 滚动；卷形物；
words.ex: The ball roll down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球从山上滚下来。
words.en: To move somewhere by turning over and over, or to make something move in this way.

words.tr: n. 火锅；热锅炖菜；罐焖菜肴
words.ex: We had hotpot for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们晚餐吃了罐焖土豆烧肉。
words.en: A hotpot is a dish that is cooked and served in a pot at the table, typically containing a variety of meats, vegetables, and sometimes noodles or tofu, cooked in a simmering pot of stock at the table.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.ex: This phone meets my needs.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机满足我的需求。
words.en: To satisfy or fulfill someone's requirements or desires.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr: phrase. 大范围的；范围广泛的
words.ex: The store has a wide range of toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的儿童玩具。
words.en: A wide range of means there is a large variety or a great number of different things within a particular category.

words.ex: The room is well-lit by the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间由大窗户采光，很明亮。
words.en: A place that is well-lit has plenty of light.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: The movie shows a fantasy, not reality.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示的是幻想，而不是现实。
words.en: Reality is the state of things as they actually exist, rather than as they may appear or might be imagined.

words.ex: He is wearing a headset to experience virtual reality.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着头盔体验虚拟现实。
words.en: Virtual reality is an artificial environment that is created with software and presented to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and accepts it as a real environment.

words.tr: n. 戴在头上的耳机或听筒
words.ex: He wears a headset to listen to music.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着耳机听音乐。
words.en: A headset is a pair of headphones, especially one with a microphone attached.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He will reach out to his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会联系他的朋友。
words.en: To reach out means to extend one's hand outward in order to touch or grasp something, or to make contact with someone, especially in order to offer help or support.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.ex: The child likes to hand-feed bread to the ducks at the park.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在公园里亲手喂面包给鸭子。
words.en: To feed someone or something by hand, especially when they are unable to feed themselves.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.tr: adj. 担心的；关注的； v. 涉及到；“concern”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My parents are concerned about my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母对我的成绩感到担心。
words.en: If you are concerned about something, you are worried about it.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: He is getting used to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他正在习惯早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone, so that it/they no longer seem(s) new, strange, or difficult.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: phrase. 走进；介入；开始参与（某事）
words.ex: He steps into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地走进房间。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a situation or role.

words.tr: adj. 穿戴舒适的；可穿戴的
words.ex: This wearable jacket feels soft and light on the skin.
words.ex_cn: 这件穿戴舒适的夹克穿在身上柔软轻盈。
words.en: A wearable item is something that you can wear, especially something that is comfortable and suitable for wearing.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.tr:
v. 打；敲打；击败；
n. 一击；跳动；
words.ex: He beat the drum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他用力敲打鼓。
words.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, election, or battle; to hit someone or something many times with your hand, a stick, etc.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Before long, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 不久之后，他就会完成作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or is true before long, you mean that it will happen or is true soon.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: He rolled up his sleeve to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖子洗手。
words.en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The rover is exploring mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器正在探索火星。
words.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Named after the Roman god of war, it is often referred to as the 'Red Planet' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.

words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.tr: adj. 行星间的；太阳系内的
words.ex: The spaceship travels through interplanetary space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船在星际空间中航行。
words.en: Existing or occurring between planets.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr:
adj. 火星的；
n. 火星人；
words.ex: The martian soil is red and dusty.
words.ex_cn: 火星的土壤是红色且多尘的。
words.en: Relating to the planet Mars or its hypothetical inhabitants.

words.tr: phrase. 温室效应；指大气层中某些气体吸收并重新辐射地面热量，导致地球表面温度升高的现象
words.ex: The greenhouse effect makes the Earth warmer.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应使地球变暖。
words.en: The process by which gases in the Earth's atmosphere trap heat, leading to a gradual increase in global temperatures.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: The astronaut wears a spacesuit in space.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在太空中穿着宇航服。
words.en: A spacesuit is a garment worn by astronauts to protect them from the harsh conditions of space, including vacuum, extreme temperatures, and radiation.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: The ice cap is melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 冰盖因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: An ice cap is a large, thick layer of ice that covers less than 50,000 square kilometers of land area. It is smaller than an ice sheet.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.ex: The water vapor rose into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升上了天空。
words.en: Vapor is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapor can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.tr: phrase. 水蒸气; 水蒸汽; 水汽
words.ex: Water vapour rises into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升到天空中。
words.en: Water vapour is the gaseous phase of water. It is one state of water within the hydrosphere. Water vapour can be produced from the evaporation or boiling of liquid water or from the sublimation of ice. Unlike other forms of water, water vapour is invisible. Under typical atmospheric conditions, water vapour is continuously generated by evaporation and removed by condensation.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: He will go up to the city tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会前往城市。
words.en: To approach or move closer to someone or something.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: This shirt is breathable and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫透气且舒适。
words.en: Breathable describes a material that allows air to pass through it, making it comfortable to wear.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.tr:
adj. 载人的；有人操纵的
v. 操作；工作；“man”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The spaceship was manned by three astronauts.
words.ex_cn: 这艘宇宙飞船由三名宇航员驾驶。
words.en: If a vehicle or a place is manned, it has people in it who operate it or guard it.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.ex: The rocket flew into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭飞入了太空。
words.en: A rocket is a spacecraft, aircraft, or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.ex: The park was named after a famous hero.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是以一位著名英雄的名字命名的。
words.en: If you name someone or something after another person or thing, you give them the same name as that person or thing.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.
